item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Cricket fraternity reacts as Sri Lanka suffer embarrassing defeat against England in Super 8
item.description: Sri Lanka suffered an embarrassing 51-run defeat at the hands of England in their opening T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 fixture in Pallekele on Sunday (February 22). item.title: MS Dhoni unlikely to feature in all IPL 2026 games for CSK: Report
item.description: MS Dhoni featured in the IPL 2025 season for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) at the age of 43. He returned to the leadership role after regular skipper Ruturaj Gaikwad was ruled out midway through the tournament due to injury. However, Dhoni failed to turn CSK’s fortunes around as the five-time champions became the first team to be knocked out of the playoffs race and finished last in the points table for the first time ever. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Cricket fraternity lauds Jasprit Bumrah’s stunning bowling display in Super 8 clash vs South Africa
item.description: Jasprit Bumrah delivered a remarkable spell in India’s T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 opener against South Africa at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on Sunday (February 22). Opting to bowl first, India reduced South Africa to 20/3 as Bumrah wreaked havoc with the new ball. The right-arm quick dismissed Quinton de Kock and Ryan Rickelton. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Gautam Gambhir faces flak online after Axar Patel excluded from important IND v SA game in Ahmedabad
item.description: India faced South Africa in their first Super 8s game in the T20 World Cup 2026 on February 22, 2026. South Africa captain Aiden Markram won the toss and chose to bat first on the Narendra Modi Stadium pitch in Ahmedabad. While South Africa made four changes to their side, India decided to field the same XI that played against the Netherlands at this same venue. Indian captain Suryakumar Yadav revealed that Axar Patel will continue to warm the bench as India went with Washington Sundar instead.
